data.body:
Closing. All five stories are closed and their Gerrit changes are MERGED with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 (checked on Gerrit 2026-10-26 04:55 PDT): 3f35-f1af-7a0f-4376 -> change 3050, bbce-1846-1dd1-49ca -> 3053, 7300-7fab-807c-4ea0 -> 3054, a757-f58a-34cc-4ad1 -> 3114, e873-b770-693c-4ff5 -> 3117 (merged main HEAD 27772912f3a). The epic's plan review certified on the reworded criteria (checked 05:04 PDT; 5 advisories, answered below).

The acceptance criteria were reworded before closing, because they quoted plan-time numbers the stories refined; each change is named in the 'Delivered differently from plan' section of the description. This was a change to acceptance wording that was originally approved by the operator on 2026-09-06; it is flagged to the user in chat and reversible by reopening.

Per criterion, on merged main (between 04:50 and 05:07 PDT, 2026-10-26):
1. Seam story: recorded on 3f35: 464 nodes before = 147 kept + 43 moved + 274 deleted; change 3050 merged.
2. Parity story: recorded on bbce: 49 nodes before, 42 after (30 functions + 7 new); 'scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py' runs from make lint (Makefile:429); test_ci_workflow_parity.py defines 30 test functions today.
3. Single-owner: 'make lint' runs 25 scripts/check_*.py; the census tests/unit/test_make_lint_hygiene_wiring.py lists 25 (51 passed, recorded on 7300 at 17:24 PDT on 2026-10-25); 7300 added check_adr_numbers.py and check_docs_index.py to lint; check_readme_quickstart.py stays CI-owned because it executes the quickstart; the other scripts that keep a non-lint owner are named in 7300's description.
4. Ruff: TID251 and TID253 are both in [tool.ruff.lint].select; the tests-rooted scan helper is gone (git grep finds 0 files); the heavy-stack scan remains narrowed at tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py:115 (test_no_core_module_imports_heavy_stack_nested_at_module_scope) because TID253 only inspects top-level imports; four ratchet tests in tests/unit/test_ruff_ratchet.py pin the settings. Red proofs are on a757.
5. Durations: '.test_durations' is tracked, 19862 keys == 19862 collected ids, 0 collected nodes without a key and 0 keys without a node; evidence on e873.
6. 'make verify' per story: each story's run failed only on the 17 known arm64 pandoc tests (3f35: 17 failed / 19701 passed; bbce: 17 / 19700; 7300: 17 / 19727; a757: 17 pandoc only; e873: 17 failed / 19746 passed), and every story's change reached Verified +1.
Mechanism census: 'python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check' prints active=651 new=25 increased=0 stale=0 on merged main, identical to main before a757.

Advisories from the epic review: (P5, P6) generic, no action. (G3) three children's own criteria omit the Verified +1 half; all five changes do have Verified +1 (Gerrit, above). (G4) bbce planned for the optionality item count to go 10 -> 9 in a757; a757 kept it at 10 and it is 10 on main (tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py:654), so bbce's handoff note is a stale remark on a closed story. (T7) a docs sweep: I checked the tests/ and scripts/ paths named in docs, AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md and README.md (history under docs/archive, docs/experiments and docs/adr excluded): 15 distinct paths no longer exist; 14 predate this epic or belong to other epics (the MCP, editor and read-engine removals, and old gerrit setup scripts); ONE is ours: docs/architecture.md:537 says a seam 'is pinned by tests/unit/test_prompt_model_module_seam.py', which 3f35 deleted (commit 441ca94f4a8). It is filed as a follow-up task so it is fixed with its own review and gate run.

Follow-up tasks from this epic: assiduous-ribbony-mousebird (regression test for the gitleaks fake-PEM allowlist), uncommon-floatable-chamois (unused GATE constants left in two test modules), and the docs fix above. Unverified: whether a scan that is only visible in CI flags .test_durations (CI passed on the Linux gate for change 3117); that the committed profile is useful for real splitting, since nothing in CI consumes it yet.
